Local Android compatibility patch on native-tls 0.2.18.
Only changes Android system CA-store selection: prefer the nonempty Conscrypt APEX
store, then the legacy system CA directory. Keep the existing X.509 parsing,
OpenSSL certificate verification, and hostname verification. Do not merge roots
from an older system image into the active updatable store. No global environment
changes and no trust-all override.
Primary platform reference:
https://android.googlesource.com/platform/prebuilts/fullsdk/sources/+/refs/heads/androidx-constraintlayout-release/android-35/com/android/org/conscrypt/TrustedCertificateStore.java
The complete new RGB-lib checkout remains unchanged at its pinned commit.
